facilities.name: Constellation Beer DC - Jurupa Valley CA
facilities.source: Commercial Observer 2023 - Constellation preleased 1.4M sq ft at the 'Space Center' development (Link Logistics/Blackstone) near I-15/SR-60 in Riverside County; primary US receiving/distribution hub for Mexico-origin beer. Highest-volume yard site.

facilities.name: Constellation Beer DC - Wilmer TX (Dallas I-45)
facilities.address: I-45 corridor / southern Dallas County, Wilmer, TX (approx.)
facilities.source: Good Beer Hunting Sightlines 2016 + Biagi Bros/Evans GC: 450-475K sq ft build-to-suit cross-dock for Constellation beer, rail-served (can unload four 30-car trains), 24 rail + 64 truck dock doors; operated by 3PL Biagi Bros in the I-45 corridor near Dallas. Exact street address not published.

facilities.name: Constellation Beer DC - Jacksonville FL
facilities.address: 600 Whittaker Road, Imeson Industrial Park, Jacksonville, FL 32218
facilities.source: Jacksonville Daily Record 2022 - 469,830 sq ft warehouse on 24 acres, ~1.5 mi east of I-95; first Constellation DC in North Florida; receives beer by rail, distributes by truck; 54 docks plus trailer yard and guard house.

facilities.name: Constellation Gonzales Winery - Gonzales CA
facilities.source: California Sustainable Winegrowing + cbrands locations: Monterey County production winery; Constellation invested in tank expansion raising Central Coast crush capacity from 70K to 80K tons. Retained after 2025 Wine Group sale.

facilities.name: Robert Mondavi Winery - Oakville CA
facilities.source: cbrands.com/Napa Valley listings - flagship Napa winery (To Kalon Vineyard); reopened April 2026 after multi-year transformation. Core retained premium asset post-2025 divestiture.

facilities.name: The Prisoner Wine Company - St. Helena CA
facilities.source: St. Helena / Napa Valley tourism listings - Napa Valley winery and production estate; retained premium brand post-2025 Wine Group sale.

facilities.name: Mount Veeder Winery / Franciscan Estate - Napa CA
facilities.address: Mount Veeder area, Napa, CA (vineyard at 1999 Mount Veeder Rd; tasting at 930 3rd St, Napa 94559)
facilities.source: Napa Wine Project - acquired with Franciscan Winery in 1999; houses Mount Veeder, Schrader, To Kalon Vineyard Co, Double Diamond brands. Retained post-2025.

facilities.name: Booker Vineyard / My Favorite Neighbor - Paso Robles CA
facilities.source: Wine Spectator / Yelp - Constellation holds majority/option stake; produces the My Favorite Neighbor Cabernet brand retained in the premium portfolio.

facilities.name: Sea Smoke Cellars - Lompoc CA
facilities.address: 1604 N. O Street, Lompoc, CA 93436 (winemaking; vineyard at 111 Mail Rd)
facilities.source: winetasting.com / American Winery Guide - Santa Rita Hills (Santa Barbara) producer; retained gem in Constellation premium wine portfolio.

facilities.name: Lingua Franca Winery - Salem OR
facilities.source: Oregon Wine Board / linguafranca.wine - Willamette Valley estate winery, acquired by Constellation April 2022; retained premium brand.

facilities.name: High West Distillery - Wanship UT
facilities.source: High West / Whiskey Lore - main production distillery (Park City area); retained craft spirits brand. Note: Nelson's Green Brier Distillery, 1414 Clinton St, Nashville TN 37203 is also retained but is primarily a small urban tasting/production site.
